scope: parameter preparation only; no field replay or reference acceptance

coordinate_convention.room: historical room right-handed frame, z-up; confirm floor-zero relationship
coordinate_convention.body: base_footprint axes x forward, y left, z up
coordinate_convention.yaw: body +X toward room +X is 0 rad; +Y pi/2; -Y -pi/2
coordinate_convention.point: UWB antenna reference center; not marker center, enclosure center or chassis geometric center

antenna_body_xy_m.definition: vector from physical odometry/base_footprint origin to antenna, expressed in body axes
not_substitutes: geometric-center offset without base origin validation

antenna_height_m.definition: absolute antenna Z in room/floor frame; planar model uses only this sum
antenna_height_m.uncertainty_policy: null plus reason if not measured; never insert zero uncertainty

initial_antenna_xy_room_m.definition: actual antenna XY at the explicitly bound odometry record; nominal route is only a candidate

initial_body_yaw_room_rad.definition: actual vehicle/body heading at same bound record; marker yaw needs an independently supplied marker-to-body rotation

initial_record_binding.policy: initialization only at matching arrived source record; no endpoint-derived initialization

geometry.initial_base_derivation: p_base_xy = p_antenna_xy - R(body_yaw)*antenna_body_xy; uncertainty/correlation must be separately assessed

clock.grouping: one host ROS clock per vehicle can be shared only after deployment/time-mode evidence; per-topic sampling-to-stamp semantics remain separate
clock.master: bag_receive_epoch_ns recorder ROS clock; not an independently calibrated physical time guarantee
clock.offset_sign: negative if physical sample occurred before host header stamp
clock.uncertainty_combination: sum of declared absolute bounds; no independence assumption
clock.pending_policy: NTP synchronized, negative receipt-header or its median cannot supply these fields

provenance_requirements: asset or document identity and SHA256
uncertainty value or null plus reason
not_algorithm_prerequisites: base_height and lever_z separately if antenna_height is provided
evaluation_prerequisites: space/time uncertainty and common valid evaluation window
